trust_decision.summary: Admin module 'save' action trusts the array keys of POST configuration[] as configuration_key and concatenates them unescaped into the val_function lookup query; the later UPDATE on the same key is already escaped.

landing_point.why: Advisory names modules.php Module Configuration; the save action has exactly one unescaped query, directly beside an escaped UPDATE on the same key.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route found; the sibling admin/configuration.php save path keys by (int) configuration_id (admin/configuration.php:61,65), and the repository helpers escape their keys (includes/classes/DbRepositories/ConfigurationRepository.php:61,79), so nothing is left that a solver could argue away.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Multi-select module settings post configuration[KEY][] arrays that are imploded and stripped of '--none--' before saving; values may legitimately contain quotes or symbols (escaped at the UPDATE). Over-broad filtering of values or rejection of array input would break these saves.

O6_input_shapes: configuration[<key>] = string value (key is the injected part)
configuration[<key>][] = array value, imploded (key still injected)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A variant of the config-group save that looks up val_function by configuration_key taken from the posted array key instead of the (int) id.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: modules.php already uses the key-based form for the identical lookup; a maintainer unifying the two saves could copy that form.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A getValFunctionByKey() repository helper that omits prepare_input, called from the module save.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Neighbouring repository methods take a raw string key; the escaping is per method, not centralised.

O9_family: SQL injection (string-literal context, key taken from user-controlled array index)

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8.x + composer; PHPUnit test framework under not_for_release/testFramework
services: web server (or PHP built-in) for admin feature tests
O10_build.project_tests: not_for_release/testFramework/FeatureAdmin/AdminEndpoints/* covers other admin pages; no test found for modules.php save

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap $key in zen_db_input() at admin/modules.php:74 (which is also the complete published fix).

out_of_scope_notes: admin/modules.php:67-85 writes any posted configuration_key, not only keys in $module->keys(), so an admin can change unrelated settings through the module form (an authorization/scope question, not SQLi).

zc_install/includes/classes/class.zcDatabaseInstaller.php:395 and zc_install/includes/classes/class.systemChecker.php:403 concatenate keys unescaped, but those keys come from installer-internal data, not requests.
includes/classes/PluginSupport/ScriptedInstallHelpers.php:160 builds an IN list from $keys_list without visible escaping at that line; plugin-author input, not checked.
unverified: j_defence_ineffective=1 is based on the admin sanitizer covering 'configuration' values only, not array keys (admin/includes/init_includes/init_sanitize.php:240-241, admin/includes/classes/AdminRequestSanitizer.php:737-740). Whether STRICT_SANITIZE_VALUES traversal touches keys was not fully checked.
